description: This file defines the EmployeeActionSummaryDao class, which is a Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for retrieving various counts and summaries related to employee actions, such as scheduled interviews, pending reviews, and self-reviews in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeActionSummaryDao
classes.description: This DAO class provides methods to fetch counts related to scheduled interviews, reviews, and self-assessments for employees within the HR management system, utilizing various query builder wrappers.

methods.name: getActionableScheduledInterviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of candidates with scheduled interviews based on provided candidate IDs.

methods.name: getPendingAppraisalReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the number of pending appraisal reviews filtered by specific parameters.

methods.name: getPendingSelfReviewCount
methods.description: Counts the pending self-review tasks for a specific employee based on filter parameters.
